function.description: Provide Uniswap v3 liquidity, creating the pool when initial_price is supplied, or increase your token_id. Needs exact token approvals first. Both legs are bounded by the guard. protocol='v4': a launchpad's graduated pool (full range, LP fee 0), or a NEW pool / custom range that the owner declares on a card first (see protocol). dry_run defaults true.
function.name: defi_trade_lp_add

amount_a.description: Most of token_a to deposit, in whole token units (not raw). Omit only with seed=.

amount_b.description: Most of token_b to deposit, in whole token units (not raw). Omit only with seed=.

chain.description: Chain to manage the Uniswap v3 position on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) simulates and asserts without broadcasting.

fragment.description: Set true ONLY to knowingly open a separate pool for a Pons token still on its bonding curve (that fragments its market); otherwise such a deposit is refused.

hooks.description: v4 only, with tick_spacing: the PoolKey's hook address; omit for a pool with no hook.

initial_price.description: Only to CREATE a pool that does not exist yet: the starting price as token_b per token_a. Omit for an existing pool.

max_spend_usd.description: The most USD both legs plus gas may cost.

protocol.description: 'v3', or 'v4'. v4 has three forms: a new FULL-RANGE position on a Pons graduated pool (token_a/token_b = 'native' + the Pons token); a pool the OWNER must declare — name the PoolKey in full (fee + tick_spacing, hooks if any, range, both amounts, initial_price) and the call sends NOTHING, it puts one card to the owner; and seed=<ref> to build that declared position. Every v4 add needs an ERC-20 allowance to Permit2 and approve_token(via='permit2') first; capped by LP_ETH_CAP.

range.description: full, low,high prices in token_b/token_a, or ticks:low,high in sorted token order.

seed.description: v4 only: the id of a pool declaration (from the proposal). The pool, range, amounts and price come from the declaration and nothing else you pass is read but chain, max_spend_usd and dry_run. A live send needs the owner's Confirm.

tick_spacing.description: v4 only: the PoolKey's tick spacing. Giving it names a PoolKey in full and makes this call a PROPOSAL to the owner (a card), never a transaction. Here range is 'full' or 'ticks:lo,hi', and slippage_bps is the allowed price gap (max 500).

token_a.description: Contract address or 'native'. Omit only with seed=.

token_b.description: Contract address or 'native'. Omit only with seed=.

token_id.description: Your existing position NFT id to ADD to. Omit to mint a new position.
